attempts.answer:
For **AI Meme Arena** at **aimemearena.com**:

* **Developer / Initiator:** The project was created and started by **Vladimir Zakoulov** (founder of FunCorp) along with his team ("команда Фанатиков"). Zakoulov publicly identified himself as the initiator (*"стартер @AIMemeArenaBot"* / creator of the AI Meme Arena initiative), and the official Challenge page for the platform directs developers seeking compute grants to contact him directly (*"По вопросам compute-грантов, напишите @vladimirzakoulov"* / *"Мы сделали AI Meme Arena"*).
* **Provider Brand:** Software directories such as G2 also catalog and attribute the software at `aimemearena.com` directly under the vendor/provider brand name **AI Meme Arena** (*"Aimemearena by AI Meme Arena"*).
